content.short: OKX Wallet is a powerful crypto wallet.
content.description: OKX Wallet is a secure Web3 wallet that puts you in control of your crypto, NFTs, and other digital assets, all in one place. It includes built-in access to a multi-chain DEX, an NFT Marketplace, Earn programs, and thousands of dApps across more than 50 blockchains. You maintain full control of your crypto, keys, and data, choosing what to share and what to keep private, with a unified experience that spans your assets across supported networks and keeps you current with evolving Web3 tools.
content.meta: OKX Wallet is a Web3 wallet to explore Web3 and manage crypto, NFTs, and digital assets.
